name: ProductionCallSheetBuilder
tagline: Build, check, publish and confirm tomorrow's call sheet in one app.
description: Full Power Apps code-component app for film & TV production: shoot days, scene schedule, cast / crew / background calls, turnaround and HMU-lead checks, a readiness checklist, versioned publishing, distribution and confirmation tracking and a day timeline – with demo data, low-code column mapping and Power Fx events.
features: Call sheet document: crew / shooting call, est. wrap, location, nearest hospital, weather, scenes, cast, background, crew by department
Turnaround check against the previous wrap (configurable hours, blocking)
HMU / costume lead check, long-day warning, duplicate calls
Scene cast coverage – cast in a scene who are not called, declined or released
Versioned publish & send, edits after sending become 'Changed'
Distribution board with drag-and-drop and keyboard moves, reminders
Bulk send / confirm / release / shift ±15 min, undo, CSV export
Plain-text call sheet output for Outlook / Teams
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, 12/24-hour clock
